body: Can you provide console output for those errors please?

For example,

``` js
  161:59  error  Wrapping non-IIFE function literals in parens is unnecessary  no-wrap-func
```

for [this](https://github.com/zloirock/core-js/blob/master/modules/es6.promise.js#L161) line.
Looks like a parenthesized callee confuses the rule.

I started to work on a solution but I realized that I was wildly overlapping with `no-extra-parens`. I'm a little bit confused about what the scope of both rules should be. Isn't `no-wrap-func` just a particular case of the former?
Yes. For people that want unnecessary parentheses everywhere except around function expressions.
`no-extra-parens` does not warn on IIFEs so that it does not overlap with _this rule's original intent_. Since then, however, this rule has changed.

We try to avoid overlaps in warnings, sometimes it happens without us noticing.

It might make sense to combine at this point, but I'm not sure of the correct option names.

issue.title: Fix: adds "functions-only" option to no-extra-parens (fixes #2477)

issue.body:
By adding `"functions-only"` as a configuration option, `no-extra-parens` should be able to substitute `no-wrap-func`.

I'll add documentation and/or deprecation notes once it gets the LGTM's.

A couple of discrepancies with `no-wrap-func`:
1. This code is currently reported as erroneous:
   
   ``` js
   var x = (function foo() {}).length;
   ```
   
   while `no-wrap-func` accepts it. They are strictly speaking redundant parenthesis. IMHO it's usual to keep them for readability.
2. Function expressions as statements don't get reported:
   
   ``` js
   (function foo() {});
   ```
   
   while `no-wrap-func` does report them. I'm not sure why this exception was made. The only test for it is [this](https://github.com/eslint/eslint/blob/40353732976da89e8902b6839e625f044ab4ed7d/tests/lib/rules/no-extra-parens.js#L121).

I also added an extra check for extra-extra parenthesis in IIFEs:

``` js
// Reported
((function foo() {}))();
```

body: I think the intention is to deprecate `no-wrap-func` and use the "functions" option in [`no-extra-parens`](http://eslint.org/docs/rules/no-extra-parens) instead
